name.zh: 瞬态—已提交表面几何分离

intent: 将拖动/缩放过程中的临时几何与已提交、可恢复的工作区布局分离，避免旋转、窄视口、手势取消或临时 clamp 污染用户的长期布局。
use_when: 存在可拖动/缩放的工具表面
布局需要 Activity/process 恢复
同一布局会经历不同 viewport/inset
do_not_use_when: 不存在持久几何或恢复语义

interaction_contract.drag: may render transient translation without rewriting committed geometry each frame
interaction_contract.resize: candidate outline/geometry is committed on release; cancel discards candidate
interaction_contract.viewport: projection/clamp is temporary and does not overwrite larger saved geometry
interaction_contract.lock: layout lock affects presentation movement, not the tool's domain binding or editability

visual_contract.resize_feedback: transient outline or equivalent feedback may be used while content remains at committed size
visual_contract.reachability: compact headers may scroll actions horizontally rather than hiding them

constraints: Surface geometry contains no domain values or subtitle undo state.
Presentation order changes must not mutate document state.
Invalid persisted rows should be skipped individually rather than invalidating the whole workspace.
Temporary viewport constraints must not destroy canonical layout intent.
